title: Ambiance exercise and step 16 of controlled remote viewing training

tellings.quote:
We have a thing called the ambiance
exercise.

plain: Lyn Buchanan is a former US Army sergeant who says he served in the military's remote viewing programme, an effort to train people to describe distant or hidden things using only the mind. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he describes a training drill he calls the ambiance exercise, part of a later stage of the structured method known as controlled remote viewing. He shares it to show how the training was meant to work in practice.
